verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents a first-party Browser Agent SDK built as four composable packages for adding voice agents to web apps. Its getting-started guide covers Python, JavaScript, C#, and Go, and an official Node.js starter repo is linked. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming the server-side language SDKs as official SDKs for the Voice Agent API, SDK reference depth (versioning, API coverage), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Browser Agent SDK: add voice AI to any web application via four composable packages.
step-by-step guide to creating your first voice agent with Python, JavaScript, C#, or Go.
